insider_transactions.details: Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange that pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and para 202.05 read with para 202.06 of the NYSE Listed Company Manual, it is hereby informed that Wipro Limited through its step-down subsidiary - Wipro IT Services, LLC has signed a definitive agreement to acquire 20% shareholding in FLARRE.AI, Inc. on October 15, 2026.

announcements.summary: Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Grant of Restricted Stock Units'.
Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange about Company statement on the U.S. Permanent Labor Certification Program

Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 18,832 equity shares under ADS Restricted Stock Unit Plan 2004, 52,075 equity shares under the Restricted Stock Unit Plan 2007 and      17,373 equity shares under Employee Stock Options, Performance Stock Unit and Restricted Stock Unit Scheme 2024 on October 14, 2026, pursuant to exercise of ESOPs.
Wipro Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 15, 2026, titled "Wipro announces results for the Quarter ended September 30, 2026".
Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Auditor's Report on financial statements for the quarter and half year endedSeptember 30, 2026 with UDIN'.

Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange that the audio and video recording of the earnings press conference held on October 15, 2026 is available on the Company s website at https://www.wipro.com/newsroom/press-releases/2026/wipro-press-conference-q2-fy-2026-2027/

Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange that pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and para 202.05 read with para 202.06 of the NYSE Listed Company Manual, it is hereby informed that Wipro Limited through its step-down subsidiary - Wipro IT Services, LLC has signed a definitive agreement to acquire 20% shareholding in FLARRE.AI, Inc. on October 15, 2026.
